sentences.text: The SSSHG scheme stands for the "Sustainable Livelihoods and Self-Employment for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes" program.
It aims to enhance the livelihoods of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes through sustainable self-employment opportunities.
The objectives include promoting self-reliance among marginalized communities and improving their socio-economic status.
Benefits include financial assistance for setting up small enterprises and skill development training.
Eligible beneficiaries are individuals from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes who are above the age of 18.
The application process typically involves submitting a form along with necessary documents to the designated authority.
The timeline for processing applications may vary but is generally completed within a few weeks.
The implementing authorities include the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and various state governments.
Additional details may include periodic reviews and monitoring of the scheme's impact on beneficiaries.
